msContents.summary: Sale agreement concerning a slave. Taorseus, daughter of Onnophris and her mother Tanese..?.., authorized Pachompetenephotes to sell her slave Narcissus, while the revenue is due to herself. Subscription in Demotic.

msItem.title: Mandate concerning the sale of a slave

In year 20 of Imperator Caesar
Trajan Optimus Augustus Germanicus
Dacicus Parthicus, Choiak 11? in --- of the
Thebaid before the notaries NN, son of Ammonios and NN,
son of Gaius. Thus acknowledges Taouerseous,
daughter of Onnophris and the mother Senesentis?, one of those from
Elephantine, 41 years old, ---,
with her guardian Pachompaonnophris, son of Pha---, priest of
Ammon the great god, to Pachompetenephotes,
son of Onnophris and the mother Tisatis, priest of Isis?, the
the great godess, to having appointed him as mandatary for
the purpose of selling the houseborn slave belonging to her,
whose name is Narkissos, 8 years old, with a mark on the
right hand, born out of her own deceased
female slave Aphrodite, on the condition that
Pachompetenephotes shall sell the slave Narkissos and
shall hand over the price for him, acting on his own
good faith, to the aforesaid Taouerseous in full.
It shall be permitted to him to proceed with regard to
the aforesaid slave however he chooses, and the
contract whichever he will draw up concerning him (the slave) shall be valid as
if she herself was present.
